body:
New stdlib/deadweight/fx_rules.prn extracts round-resolution scenario/winner/crit/timeline/cue decision logic from DEADWEIGHT's hand-written fx.c, compiled to C (Windows, canonical) and TS (browser). Caught a real logic bug (fx-scenario hardcoded BLITZ for one branch) via a 64-case cross-check before it ever reached fx.c. Also fixed emit_ts.c never recognizing true/false literals (found via fx-is-crit). test_emit_ts.c 30->34 assertions. Commit 89ba473.

⚓ ☃
title: fx_rules.prn: shared DEADWEIGHT animation/audio decision layer + true/false emit_ts fix
